findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_vendor_fact_sheet, search_content, get_kb_article, get_category_landscape, submit_correction · Private data: detect_stack_from_text · Public sink: get_vendor_fact_sheet, submit_correction · Destructive: scan_stack.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_vendor_fact_sheet, search_content, get_kb_article, get_category_landscape, submit_correction · Private data: detect_stack_from_text · Public sink: get_vendor_fact_sheet, submit_correction · Destructive: scan_stack

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
